items.p: Designing scalable AWS systems, leading engineering and CI/CD pipelines, and driving uptime and reliability.
Architecting production workloads with Angular, NestJS, Flutter and Ionic — with security baked in from the start.
Continuously modernizing my stack and sharpening front-of-stack craft alongside backend and infrastructure work.

about.bio1: I'm Bilel Hedhli — a Technical Lead and Full-Stack Engineer based in Tunis, Tunisia, with over 5 years delivering innovative, scalable, cloud-driven software.
about.bio2: I build complex systems with JavaScript technologies — Angular, Node.js, React, Next.js — integrate cloud platforms like AWS, Firebase and Docker, and streamline delivery with CI/CD pipelines. I've led cross-functional teams, modernized legacy codebases, and shipped real-time healthcare and business applications end to end.
about.bio3: I care about secure design, clean architecture, and the operational discipline that keeps production systems fast and reliable.
about.award: ★ First Prize, Orange POESAM 2023 — with eSteps Health
